title: Quote: Apple is the most creative of the PC companies; Pixar is the...
speaker: Steve Jobs
event: Steve Jobs: Singing a New Tune
content: Apple is the most creative of the PC companies; Pixar is the most technologically advanced entertainment company. [Apple releases new products every few months, and top execs make 10 major decisions a day.] But the Holy Grail for Pixar is releasing one product -- a movie-a-year, and as CEO I might make three really critical decisions a year, and they are very hard to change.
full_transcript: Apple is the most creative of the PC companies; Pixar is the most technologically advanced entertainment company. [Apple releases new products every few months, and top execs make 10 major decisions a day.] But the Holy Grail for Pixar is releasing one product -- a movie-a-year, and as CEO I might make three really critical decisions a year, and they are very hard to change.
